projects.title: Traffic Light Controller System
projects.summary: Multi-controller traffic synchronization system utilizing Arduino, ESP8266, Raspberry Pi, and classic AT89C51 microcontroller.
projects.description: Developed and compared comprehensive traffic light control architectures across 4 distinct microcontrollers: Arduino Uno, ESP8266 Wi-Fi module, Raspberry Pi SBC, and AT89C51 8051-core. Designed timer state machines, density-based signal priority logic, and real-time Proteus circuit simulations.
highlights: Tested multi-platform controller responses for traffic intersection sequencing
Integrated AT89C51 assembly/C code and Arduino C++ timers
Demonstrated wireless synchronization over ESP8266

projects.title: Automatic Toll Gate
projects.summary: Automated vehicle detection and toll booth barrier system with contactless triggering and secure gate pass mechanics.
projects.description: Engineered an automated toll gate management model incorporating obstacle and proximity detection sensors with high-torque micro-servo motor barrier actuation. Streamlines throughput and reduces transit queuing times.
highlights: Instant proximity sensing and automated barrier gate actuation
Debounce and fail-safe safety timers to avoid barrier obstruction
Efficient low-power embedded control loop

projects.title: Smart Home Automation
projects.summary: Remote wireless appliance control and monitoring system over Wi-Fi with web-based triggers.
projects.description: Implemented an Internet-of-Things smart home ecosystem enabling users to wirelessly toggle and schedule home appliances (lights, fans, systems) via a local network and responsive web interface using ESP8266 and multi-channel optocoupler relays.
highlights: Multi-relay switching with electrical isolation and protection
Responsive web dashboard control from any smartphone or laptop
Real-time feedback on appliance operational state

projects.title: Leaf Disease Detection using Image Processing
projects.summary: Agricultural computer vision pipeline that automatically analyzes plant leaf photographs to detect and classify crop diseases.
projects.description: Designed a digital image processing workflow in Python that ingests leaf images, executes color thresholding, contrast normalization, segmentation, and feature extraction to identify biological distress and disease patterns in agricultural crops.
highlights: Automated leaf segmentation and defect isolation
Color-space conversion (RGB to HSV / Lab) for lesion detection
Provides farmers with early alerts to protect crop yield

projects.title: Temperature & Humidity Monitoring System & Web App
projects.summary: End-to-end IoT atmospheric telemetry system streaming real-time temperature and humidity to a live web monitoring dashboard.
projects.description: Built a comprehensive environmental monitoring stack utilizing an ESP8266 Wi-Fi microcontroller reading precision temperature and humidity from digital sensors. The hardware sends telemetry payloads to an Express.js backend and real-time interactive UI with charts and threshold alerts.
highlights: Continuous ambient atmospheric logging with sub-second responsiveness
Interactive web dashboard displaying real-time gauges and history logs
Automatic warning thresholds for high heat or extreme humidity
